name: Crime Data from 2020 to Present
published_by: City of Los Angeles, Los Angeles Police Department
status: Retired. LAPD moved to a new records system on 7 March 2024 and this dataset is no longer updated.
replacement: LAPD NIBRS Offenses and NIBRS Victims datasets, which start on 7 March 2024 and use different definitions
kept_in_repo: Summaries and a fixed random sample of 200,000 crimes (seed 42). Addresses, coordinates, record numbers and victim descent are left out.
